## Prevent Portal Use

---

[Power Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Power-Types)

Prevents an entity from using portals. A living entity with this power may stand inside a portal, but cannot use it to cross dimensions.

Type ID: `proviorigins:prevent_portal_use`

## Field

---

## Examples
```json
{
    "type": "proviorigins:prevent_portal_use"
}
```
